pages.title: 首页认知星图
pages.visualNorthStar: Full-screen star-map canvas: self-avatar glows center-top, other users as scattered light points, subtle constellation lines, weather particle layer, top info strip, global top navigation bar.
pages.compositionPattern: P-5 Desktop Stage: immersive canvas stage with floating chrome, self as primary focal glow, secondary points in depth, top header fixed.
continuityAnchors: Deep-space dark background #0A0E1A with subtle nebula gradient
Brand blue glow (#4A9EFF) for primary focal point and active states

pages.title: 登录 / 注册
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean dark login surface with brand wordmark, phone+code form, subtle star-field backdrop that hints at the star-map without competing.
pages.compositionPattern: Centered single-column form card over immersive dark background.

pages.title: 个人工具台
pages.visualNorthStar: Dashboard hub with pending-digest alert banner, four quick-entry tiles (素材池/知识库/迭代提醒/数据看板), recent activity feed, dark card surfaces, left sidebar optional.
pages.compositionPattern: Top alert + 2x4 quick-access grid + list feed, max-w-7xl centered.
continuityAnchors: Dark card surfaces with subtle borders

pages.title: 素材池
pages.visualNorthStar: Search/filter bar + material table/cards with status badges (pending/digesting/digested), '仅素材' watermark, floating import FAB.
pages.compositionPattern: Filter strip + data table/card grid + floating action button.
continuityAnchors: Status badge colors: yellow pending / blue digesting / green digested

pages.title: 导入素材
pages.visualNorthStar: Stepper (1 choose method / 2 parse progress / 3 confirm metadata) with drag-and-drop file area and link paste, wide layout.
pages.compositionPattern: Step indicator + single active step panel + bottom primary action.
continuityAnchors: Stepper uses brand blue active state

pages.title: 消化加工
pages.visualNorthStar: Two-column desktop layout: collapsible source preview left, AI-assisted template and subjective output right,敷衍 warning, bottom action bar.
pages.compositionPattern: Source preview column + editor column + bottom action bar.
continuityAnchors: AI template dashed border with 'AI辅助' label

pages.title: 沉淀知识原子
pages.visualNorthStar: Core card format form (core question / viewpoint / evidence / practice case), PARA category, tags, citation list, visibility radio, draft/public actions, two-column editor.
pages.compositionPattern: Long form with grouped fieldsets and sticky bottom action bar, max-w-5xl.

pages.title: 知识库
pages.visualNorthStar: PARA category sidebar + searchable atom grid with reuse/citation counts, detail panel right, sort/filter bar.
pages.compositionPattern: Category sidebar + atom grid + detail panel.

pages.title: 认知名片主页
pages.visualNorthStar: Decorated header (avatar/bio/contact/follow), tab switcher (名片/提问/更多), high-weight atom cards with interaction bar, platform badge for free users.
pages.compositionPattern: Decorated header + tabs + card feed, max-w-6xl.
continuityAnchors: High-weight card bright border, low-weight muted

pages.title: 提问看板
pages.visualNorthStar: Ask question input card, answered Q&A list, AI-avatar answer badge, like actions.

pages.title: 消息中心
pages.visualNorthStar: Filter tabs (all/cite/question/auth/system) + notification list with unread dot, inline authorization approve/reject actions.
pages.compositionPattern: Filter tabs + list rows with inline actions.

pages.title: 设置
pages.visualNorthStar: Grouped settings list (account/privacy/notifications/export/decoration/about) with chevrons, membership card at top, two-column layout with sidebar.
pages.compositionPattern: Membership card + grouped list rows, settings sidebar optional.

pages.title: 数据看板
pages.visualNorthStar: Overview KPI cards (atoms/reuse rate/iteration rate/cited), trend charts, top reused atoms, dark dashboard surfaces, wide chart layout.
pages.compositionPattern: KPI strip + chart cards + top list, multi-column grids.
